verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֑ם הָעֹלִ֣ים עִמִּ֗י בְּמַלְכ֛וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִבָּבֶֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem wə·hiṯ·yaḥ·śām hā·‘ō·lîm ‘im·mî bə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ar·taḥ·šast ham·me·leḵ mib·bā·ḇel
verses.literal: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes
verses.literalPt: Estes são os cabeças das famílias, e esta é a genealogia daqueles que subiram comigo de Babilônia, no reinado do rei Artaxerxes.

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֤י פִֽינְחָס֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔םס מִבְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר דָּנִיֵּ֑אלס מִבְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד חַטּֽוּשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê p̄î·nə·ḥās gē·rə·šō·ms mib·bə·nê ’î·ṯā·mār då̄·nī·yē·ls mib·bə·nê ḏā·wîḏ ḥaṭ·ṭūš
verses.literal: from the descendants of Phinehas Gershom from the descendants of Ithamar Daniel from the descendants of David Hattush
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Fineias: Gérson; dos filhos de Itamar: Daniel; dos filhos de Davi: Hatus;

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁכַנְיָ֔הס מִבְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖שׁ זְכַרְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ הִתְיַחֵ֥שׂ לִזְכָרִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê šə·ḵan·yå̄·hs mib·bə·nê p̄ar·‘ōš zə·ḵar·yāh wə·‘im·mōw hiṯ·ya·ḥêś liz·ḵā·rîm mê·’āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm
verses.literal: of the descendants of Shecaniah from the descendants of Parosh Zechariah and with him were registered 150 . . . men
verses.literalPt: dos filhos de Secanias, dos filhos de Parós: Zacarias, e, com ele, cento e cinquenta homens registrados nas genealogias.

verses.original: מִבְּנֵי֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְיְהֽוֹעֵינַ֖י בֶּן־ זְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê pa·ḥaṯ mō·w·’āḇ ’el·yə·hō·w·‘ê·nay ben- zə·raḥ·yāh wə·‘im·mōw mā·ṯa·yim haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Pahath-Moab Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah and with him 200 men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Paate-Moabe: Elioenai, filho de Zeraías, e, com ele, duzentos homens.

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ יַחֲזִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê šə·ḵan·yāh ben- ya·ḥă·zî·’êl wə·‘im·mōw šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Zattu Shecaniah son of Jahaziel and with him 300 . . . men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Secanias: o filho de Jaaziel, e, com ele, trezentos homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין עֶ֖בֶד בֶּן־ יוֹנָתָ֑ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ‘ā·ḏîn ‘e·ḇeḏ ben- yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·‘im·mōw ḥă·miš·šîm haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Adin Ebed son of Jonathan and with him 50 men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Adim: Ebede, filho de Jônatas, e, com ele, cinquenta homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ עֲתַלְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ‘ê·lām yə·ša‘·yāh ben- ‘ă·ṯal·yāh wə·‘im·mōw šiḇ·‘îm haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Elam Jeshaiah son of Athaliah and with him 70 men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Elão: Jesaías, filho de Atalias, e, com ele, setenta homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה זְבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ מִֽיכָאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֖וֹ שְׁמֹנִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê šə·p̄aṭ·yāh zə·ḇaḏ·yāh ben- mî·ḵā·’êl wə·‘im·mōw šə·mō·nîm haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Shephatiah Zebadiah son of Michael and with him 80 men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Sefatias: Zebadias, filho de Micael, e, com ele, oitenta homens.

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ יְחִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê yō·w·’āḇ ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh ben- yə·ḥî·’êl wə·‘im·mōw mā·ṯa·yim ū·šə·mō·nāh ‘ā·śār haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Joab Obadiah son of Jehiel and with him 218 . . . . . . men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Joabe: Obadias, filho de Jeiel, e, com ele, duzentos e dezoito homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁלוֹמִ֖ית בֶּן־ יוֹסִפְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê šə·lō·w·mîṯ ben- yō·w·sip̄·yāh wə·‘im·mōw mê·’āh wə·šiš·šîm haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Bani Shelomith son of Josiphiah and with him 160 . . . men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Selomite: o filho de Josifias, e, com ele, cento e sessenta homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בֵבַ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ בֵּבָ֑י וְעִמּ֕וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ḇê·ḇay zə·ḵar·yāh ben- bê·ḇāy wə·‘im·mōw ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·nāh haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Bebai Zechariah son of Bebai and with him 28 . . . men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Bebai: Zacarias, filho de Bebai, e, com ele, vinte e oito homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד יוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן־ הַקָּטָ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ‘az·gāḏ yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- haq·qā·ṭān wə·‘im·mōw mê·’āh wa·‘ă·śā·rāh haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the descendants of Azgad Johanan son of Hakkatan and with him 110 . . . men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Azgade: Joanã, filho de Hacatã, e, com ele, cento e dez homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִיקָם֮ אַחֲרֹנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔ם אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט יְעִיאֵ֣ל וּֽשְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî·qām ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·w·ṯām ’ĕ·lî·p̄e·leṭ yə·‘î·’êl ū·šə·ma‘·yāh wə·‘im·mā·hem šiš·šîm haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: from the later descendants of Adonikam these were their names Eliphelet Jeiel and Shemaiah and with them 60 men
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Adonicão, que eram os últimos, eis os seus nomes: Elifelete, Jeuel e Semaías, e, com eles, sessenta homens.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י בִגְוַ֖י עוּתַ֣י וְזָבוּד וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ḇiḡ·way ‘ū·ṯay wə·zå̄·ḇūḏ wə·‘im·mōw šiḇ·‘îm haz·zə·ḵā·rîm
verses.literal: and from the descendants of Bigvai both Uthai and Zaccur and with them 70 men
verses.literalPt: E dos filhos de Bigvai: Utai e Zabude, e, com eles, setenta homens.

verses.original: וָֽאֶקְבְּצֵ֗ם אֶל־ הַנָּהָר֙ הַבָּ֣א אֶֽל־ אַהֲוָ֔א וַנַּחֲנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֣ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וָאָבִ֤ינָה בָעָם֙ וּבַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּמִבְּנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י לֹא־ מָצָ֥אתִי שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·bə·ṣêm ’el- han·nā·hār hab·bā ’el- ’a·hă·wā wan·na·ḥă·neh šām yā·mîm šə·lō·šāh wā·’ā·ḇî·nāh ḇā·‘ām ū·ḇak·kō·hă·nîm ū·mib·bə·nê lê·wî lō- mā·ṣā·ṯî šām
verses.literal: Now I assembled these exiles at the canal that flows to Ahava and we camped there three days And when I searched among the people and priests I found no Levites . . . there
verses.literalPt: Ajuntei-os para o rio que corre para Aava; e ali ficamos acampados três dias. Atentei para o povo e para os sacerdotes e não achei ali nenhum dos filhos de Levi.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֡ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֡זֶר לַאֲרִיאֵ֡ל לִֽ֠שְׁמַעְיָה וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּלְיָרִ֜יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֧ן וּלְנָתָ֛ן וְלִזְכַרְיָ֥ה וְלִמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים וּלְיוֹיָרִ֥יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֖ן מְבִינִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·lə·ḥāh le·’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer la·’ă·rî·’êl liš·ma‘·yāh ū·lə·’el·nā·ṯān ū·lə·yā·rîḇ ū·lə·’el·nā·ṯān ū·lə·nā·ṯān wə·liz·ḵar·yāh wə·lim·šul·lām rā·šîm ū·lə·yō·w·yā·rîḇ ū·lə·’el·nā·ṯān mə·ḇî·nîm
verses.literal: Then I summoned the leaders Eliezer Ariel Shemaiah Elnathan Jarib Elnathan Nathan Zechariah and Meshullam as well as the teachers Joiarib and Elnathan
verses.literalPt: Então, mandei chamar a Eliézer, Ariel, Semaías, Elnatã, Jaribe, Elnatã, Natã, Zacarias e Mesulão, homens principais; também a Joiaribe e a Elnatã, que eram mestres.

verses.original: וָאוֹצִאָה אוֹתָם֙ עַל־ אִדּ֣וֹ הָרֹ֔אשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָ֖א הַמָּק֑וֹם וָאָשִׂימָה֩ בְּפִיהֶ֨ם דְּבָרִ֜ים לְ֠דַבֵּר אֶל־ אִדּ֨וֹ אָחִ֤יו הַנְּתוּנִים בְּכָסִפְיָ֣א הַמָּק֔וֹם לְהָֽבִיא־ לָ֥נוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wå̄·ʾō·ṣi·ʾå̄h ’ō·w·ṯām ‘al- ’id·dōw hā·rōš bə·ḵā·sip̄·yā ham·mā·qō·wm wā·’ā·śî·māh bə·p̄î·hem də·ḇā·rîm lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’id·dōw ’ā·ḥîw han·nə·ṯū·nīm bə·ḵā·sip̄·yā ham·mā·qō·wm lə·hā·ḇî- lā·nū mə·šā·rə·ṯîm lə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: And I sent them to Iddo the leader at Casiphia . . . . . . . . . with a message . . . for him and his kinsmen the temple servants at Casiphia . . . that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God
verses.literalPt: Eu os enviei a Ido, chefe em Casifia; e lhes pus na boca as palavras que haviam de dizer a Ido e aos netinins, seus irmãos, em Casifia, para nos trazerem ministros para a Casa do nosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאּוּ לָ֜נוּ כְּיַד־ אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ הַטּוֹבָ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ שֶׂ֔כֶל מִבְּנֵ֣י מַחְלִ֔י בֶּן־ לֵוִ֖י בֶּן־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî’·’ū lā·nū kə·yaḏ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ‘ā·lê·nū ’îš śe·ḵel mib·bə·nê maḥ·lî ben- lê·wî ben- yiś·rā·’êl wə·šê·rê·ḇə·yāh ū·ḇā·nāw wə·’e·ḥāw šə·mō·nāh ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: And since the gracious hand of our God was upon us they brought us Sherebiah a man of insight from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi the son of Israel along with his sons and brothers 18 men
verses.literalPt: Segundo a boa mão do nosso Deus sobre nós, eles nos trouxeram um homem discreto dos filhos de Mali, filho de Levi, filho de Israel; e a Serebias com seus filhos e seus irmãos: dezoito;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְאִתּ֥וֹ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה מִבְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֶחָ֥יו וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ḥă·šaḇ·yāh wə·’it·tōw yə·ša‘·yāh mib·bə·nê mə·rā·rî ’e·ḥāw ū·ḇə·nê·hem ‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: also Hashabiah together with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari and his brothers and their sons 20 men
verses.literalPt: e a Hasabias, e, com ele, Jesaías, dos filhos de Merari, seus irmãos e os filhos destes: vinte;

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַנְּתִינִ֗ים שֶׁנָּתַ֨ן דָּוִ֤יד וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נְתִינִ֖ים מָאתַ֣יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְּב֥וּ בְשֵׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- han·nə·ṯî·nîm šen·nā·ṯan dā·wîḏ wə·haś·śā·rîm la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ hal·wî·yim nə·ṯî·nîm mā·ṯa·yim wə·‘eś·rîm kul·lām niq·qə·ḇū ḇə·šê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: They also brought 220 . . . of the temple servants all designated by name David and the officials had appointed them to assist the Levites
verses.literalPt: e dos netinins, que Davi e os príncipes tinham dado para o serviço dos levitas: duzentos e vinte; todos eles mencionados por nome.

verses.original: וָאֶקְרָ֨א שָׁ֥ם צוֹם֙ עַל־ הַנָּהָ֣ר אַהֲוָ֔א לְהִתְעַנּ֖וֹת לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ וּלְטַפֵּ֖נוּ וּלְכָל־ רְכוּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·rā šām ṣō·wm ‘al- han·nā·hār ’a·hă·wā lə·hiṯ·‘an·nō·wṯ lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·ḇaq·qêš mim·men·nū de·reḵ yə·šā·rāh lā·nū ū·lə·ṭap·pê·nū ū·lə·ḵāl- rə·ḵū·šê·nū
verses.literal: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed . . . a fast so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for . . . a safe journey for us and our children with all our possessions
verses.literalPt: Publiquei um jejum ali junto ao rio Aava, para nos humilharmos diante do nosso Deus, a fim de lhe pedirmos um caminho feliz para nós, para nossos pequeninos e para toda a nossa fazenda.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֹ֗שְׁתִּי לִשְׁא֤וֹל מִן־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חַ֣יִל וּפָרָשִׁ֔ים לְעָזְרֵ֥נוּ מֵאוֹיֵ֖ב בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ כִּֽי־ אָמַ֨רְנוּ לַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֗ר יַד־ אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ עַל־ כָּל־ מְבַקְשָׁיו֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה וְעֻזּ֣וֹ וְאַפּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל־ עֹזְבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇō·šə·tî liš·’ō·wl min- ham·me·leḵ ḥa·yil ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm lə·‘ā·zə·rê·nū mê·’ō·w·yêḇ bad·dā·reḵ kî- ’ā·mar·nū lam·me·leḵ lê·mōr yaḏ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘al- kāl- mə·ḇaq·šāw lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh wə·‘uz·zōw wə·’ap·pōw ‘al kāl- ‘ō·zə·ḇāw
verses.literal: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road since we had told him . . . . . . The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him but His great anger is against all who forsake Him
verses.literalPt: Pois tive vergonha de pedir ao rei uma escolta de soldados e cavaleiros, para nos defenderem do inimigo pelo caminho, porque tínhamos dito ao rei: A mão do nosso Deus está sobre todos os que o buscam, para o bem deles; mas o seu poder e a sua ira, contra todos os que o abandonam.

verses.original: וַנָּצ֛וּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁ֥ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַל־ זֹ֑את וַיֵּעָתֵ֖ר לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nā·ṣū·māh wan·nə·ḇaq·šāh mê·’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘al- zōṯ way·yê·‘ā·ṯêr lā·nū
verses.literal: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this and He granted our request
verses.literalPt: Jejuamos e suplicamos ao nosso Deus por isso; e ele aceitou as nossas súplicas.

verses.original: וָאַבְדִּ֛ילָה מִשָּׂרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר לְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְעִמָּהֶ֥ם מֵאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’aḇ·dî·lāh miś·śā·rê hak·kō·hă·nîm šə·nêm ‘ā·śār lə·šê·rê·ḇə·yāh ḥă·šaḇ·yāh wə·‘im·mā·hem mê·’ă·ḥê·hem ‘ă·śā·rāh
verses.literal: Then I set apart twelve . . . of the leading priests together with Sherebiah Hashabiah and ten of their brothers
verses.literalPt: Separei doze dos principais dos sacerdotes, a saber, Serebias, Hasabias e, com eles, dez de seus irmãos.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁקוֹלָה לָהֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־ הַכֵּלִ֑ים תְּרוּמַ֣ת בֵּית־ אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַהֵרִ֙ימוּ֙ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְיֹעֲצָ֣יו וְשָׂרָ֔יו וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּמְצָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wå̄·ʾɛš·qō·lå̄h lā·hem ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- hak·kê·lîm tə·rū·maṯ bêṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ha·hê·rî·mū ham·me·leḵ wə·yō·‘ă·ṣāw wə·śā·rāw wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl han·nim·ṣā·’îm
verses.literal: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king his counselors his leaders and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God
verses.literalPt: Pesei-lhes a prata, e o ouro, e os vasos, isto é, a oferta para a Casa do nosso Deus, que haviam oferecido o rei, os seus conselheiros e os seus príncipes e todo o Israel que se achou ali;

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁקֲלָ֨ה עַל־ יָדָ֜ם כֶּ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ־ מֵא֣וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים וּכְלֵי־ כֶ֥סֶף מֵאָ֖ה לְכִכָּרִ֑ים זָהָ֖ב מֵאָ֥ה כִכָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·qă·lāh ‘al- yā·ḏām ke·sep̄ kik·kā·rîm šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·ḵə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ mê·’āh lə·ḵik·kā·rîm zā·hāḇ mê·’āh ḵik·kār
verses.literal: I weighed out into their hands 650 . . . . . . talents of silver articles of silver weighing 100 talents 100 talents of gold
verses.literalPt: sim, entreguei-lhes nas mãos seiscentos e cinquenta talentos de prata e vasos de prata no valor de cem talentos; cem talentos de ouro

verses.original: וּכְפֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּכְלֵ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת מֻצְהָ֤ב טוֹבָה֙ שְׁנַ֔יִם חֲמוּדֹ֖ת כַּזָּהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·p̄ō·rê zā·hāḇ ‘eś·rîm la·’ă·ḏar·ḵō·nîm ’ā·lep̄ ū·ḵə·lê nə·ḥō·šeṯ muṣ·hāḇ ṭō·w·ḇāh šə·na·yim ḥă·mū·ḏōṯ kaz·zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics and two articles of fine polished bronze as precious as gold
verses.literalPt: e vinte taças de ouro no valor de mil daricos; e dois vasos de bronze mui claro e brilhante, tão precioso como ouro.

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהַכֵּלִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְהַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ נְדָבָ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mə·rāh ’ă·lê·hem ’at·tem qō·ḏeš Yah·weh wə·hak·kê·lîm qō·ḏeš wə·hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ nə·ḏā·ḇāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then I told them You are holy to the LORD and these articles are holy The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD the God of your fathers
verses.literalPt: Eu lhes disse: Vós sois santos a Jeová, e os vasos são santos; e a prata e o ouro são ofertas voluntárias a Jeová, Deus de vossos pais.

verses.original: שִׁקְד֣וּ וְשִׁמְר֗וּ עַֽד־ תִּשְׁקְל֡וּ לִפְנֵי֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם וְשָׂרֵֽי־ הָאָב֥וֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הַלִּשְׁכ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šiq·ḏū wə·šim·rū ‘aḏ- tiš·qə·lū lip̄·nê śā·rê hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim wə·śā·rê- hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·yiś·rā·’êl bî·rū·šā·lim hal·liš·ḵō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests Levites and heads of the Israelite families
verses.literalPt: Vigiai e guardai-os até que os peseis na presença dos principais dos sacerdotes, e dos levitas, e dos cabeças das famílias de Israel, em Jerusalém, nas câmaras da Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְקִבְּלוּ֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִשְׁקַ֛ל הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֖ב וְהַכֵּלִ֑ים לְהָבִ֥יא לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·qib·bə·lū hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim miš·qal hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ wə·hak·kê·lîm lə·hā·ḇî lî·rū·šā·lim lə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Receberam os sacerdotes e os levitas o peso da prata e do ouro e os vasos, para os levarem a Jerusalém, à Casa do nosso Deus.

verses.original: וַֽנִּסְעָ֞ה מִנְּהַ֣ר אַֽהֲוָ֗א בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן לָלֶ֖כֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיַד־ אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ הָיְתָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וַיַּ֨צִּילֵ֔נוּ מִכַּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֛ב וְאוֹרֵ֖ב עַל־ הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nis·‘āh min·nə·har ’a·hă·wā biš·nêm ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn lā·le·ḵeṯ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·yaḏ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hā·yə·ṯāh ‘ā·lê·nū way·yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nū mik·kap̄ ’ō·w·yêḇ wə·’ō·w·rêḇ ‘al- had·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: On the twelfth . . . day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way
verses.literalPt: Partimos do rio Aava no duodécimo dia do primeiro mês, a fim de irmos para Jerusalém; a mão do nosso Deus esteve sobre nós, e ele nos livrou da mão do inimigo e dos que nos armavam ciladas pelo caminho.

verses.original: וַנָּב֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַנֵּ֥שֶׁב שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nā·ḇō·w yə·rū·šā·lim wan·nê·šeḇ šām yā·mîm šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: So we arrived at Jerusalem and rested there for three days
verses.literalPt: Chegamos a Jerusalém e repousamos ali três dias.

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֡י נִשְׁקַ֣ל הַכֶּסֶף֩ וְהַזָּהָ֨ב וְהַכֵּלִ֜ים בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַ֠ל יַד־ מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־ אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן־ פִּֽינְחָ֑ס וְעִמָּהֶ֞ם יוֹזָבָ֧ד בֶּן־ יֵשׁ֛וּעַ וְנֽוֹעַדְיָ֥ה בֶן־ בִּנּ֖וּי הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm hā·rə·ḇî·‘î niš·qal hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ wə·hak·kê·lîm bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘al yaḏ- mə·rê·mō·wṯ ben- ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên wə·‘im·mōw ’el·‘ā·zār ben- pî·nə·ḥās wə·‘im·mā·hem yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ ben- yê·šū·a‘ wə·nō·w·‘aḏ·yāh ḇen- bin·nui hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: On the fourth day in the house of our God we weighed out the silver and gold and sacred articles into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah the priest Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him along with the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui
verses.literalPt: No quarto dia, pesados a prata, o ouro e os vasos na Casa do nosso Deus, eles foram entregues a Meremote, filho do sacerdote Urias (e, com ele, estava Eleazar, filho de Fineias; e, com eles, estavam Jozabade, filho de Jesua, e Noadias, filho de Binui, levitas),

verses.original: בְּמִסְפָּ֥ר בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל לַכֹּ֑ל וַיִּכָּתֵ֥ב כָּֽל־ הַמִּשְׁקָ֖ל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·mis·pār bə·miš·qāl lak·kōl way·yik·kā·ṯêḇ kāl- ham·miš·qāl bā·‘êṯ ha·hî
verses.literal: Everything was verified by number and weight and the total weight was recorded at that time
verses.literalPt: tudo por conta e por peso; e todo o peso foi escrito nesse tempo.

verses.original: הַ֠בָּאִים מֵֽהַשְּׁבִ֨י בְנֵֽי־ הַגּוֹלָ֜ה הִקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹל֣וֹת׀ לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּרִ֨ים שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֤ר עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵילִ֣ים׀ תִּשְׁעִ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֗ה כְּבָשִׂים֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֔ה צְפִירֵ֥י חַטָּ֖את שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הַכֹּ֖ל עוֹלָ֥ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·’îm mê·haš·šə·ḇî ḇə·nê- hag·gō·w·lāh hiq·rî·ḇū ‘ō·lō·wṯ lê·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl pā·rîm šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl ’ê·lîm tiš·‘îm wə·šiš·šāh kə·ḇā·śîm šiḇ·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ṣə·p̄î·rê ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ šə·nêm ‘ā·śār hak·kōl ‘ō·w·lāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the exiles . . . who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel 12 . . . bulls for all Israel 96 . . . rams 77 . . . lambs and a sin offering of 12 . . . male goats All this was a burnt offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Os filhos do cativeiro que tinham voltado do exílio ofereceram holocaustos ao Deus de Israel: doze novilhos por todo o Israel, noventa e seis carneiros, setenta e sete cordeiros, doze bodes como oferta pelo pecado; tudo isso em holocaustos a Jeová.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֣וּ׀ אֶת־ דָּתֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּפַחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר וְנִשְּׂא֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם וְאֶת־ בֵּֽית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- dā·ṯê ham·me·leḵ la·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·p̄a·ḥă·wō·wṯ ‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār wə·niś·śə·’ū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·’eṯ- bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God
verses.literalPt: Entregaram os editos do rei aos sátrapas do rei e aos governadores além do rio; e estes ajudaram o povo e a Casa de Deus.
